audit_refactor: Audited the restart executor chain after rev0684 and identified the remaining non-executable ResumeTransfer branch as the next risky seam.
Promoted missing-chunk continuation from an implicit action-router field into a public typed work-order surface.
Kept transfer continuation read-only so durable scheduler/transport execution can be added later without weakening materialization and cleanup proofs.
remaining_ceiling: Transfer work orders are not yet persisted as durable scheduler rows.
No real peer transport, byte fetching, staged chunk writing, or receipt-row advancement is implemented by this revision.
Retry ownership/reclaim, overwrite replay evidence, tombstone replay, conflict replay, and trust material remain future work.
summary: Adds a read-only checkpoint resume transfer planner that turns ResumeTransfer/RetryTransfer action-router evidence into bounded peer-bound missing-chunk work orders without mutating SQLite or the filesystem.
transfer_planner_checks: plan_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_transfers consumes plan_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_actions and handles ResumeTransfer by default with optional RetryTransfer inclusion.
The planner fail-closes on QuarantineStaging, Reject, or other unsafe resume actions unless explicitly configured otherwise.
The checkpoint database is opened read-only after DB path and source/destination/staging root validation.
Each file plan reloads sync_session_apply_intents and requires fetch_remote_file/stage_remote_file evidence before emitting transfer work.
The persisted apply staging path must match the action-router staging path before any work order is emitted.
Request selection is bounded by max_chunks_per_request and max_bytes_per_request and reports deferred chunks.
Peer assignment is bounded by max_chunks_per_peer_round and max_bytes_per_peer_round and reports deferred peer work.
Work orders carry sync-resume-transfer-request:v1 idempotency keys bound to session, folder, peer, path, manifest digests, staging path, and selected chunks.
Peer request rows carry sync-resume-peer-request:v1 keys and peer schedule rows carry sync-resume-peer-schedule:v1 keys.
The rev0685 planner is intentionally read-only and does not mutate filesystem state, SQLite rows, receipt sidecars, or staged files.
